body.name: Office document drops encoded PowerShell that calls out
body.description:
An Office application starts PowerShell with an encoded command, and the same host then opens a network connection from PowerShell within fifteen minutes.

ATT&CK: T1059.001, T1566.001
opentide: 00000000-0000-4000-8003-000000000072

sequences.name: Office spawns encoded PowerShell
sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND parent_process_name:("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe")
AND process_name:("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
AND process_command_line:RGXi("\s-(e|en|enc|enco|encod|encode|encoded|encodedcommand)\s")

sequences.name: PowerShell connects out
sequences.query:
activity_type:"network-connection" AND process_name:("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
AND NOT dest_ip:[10.0.0.0/8] AND NOT dest_ip:[172.16.0.0/12] AND NOT dest_ip:[192.168.0.0/16]

alertTriage.name: Office document drops encoded PowerShell that calls out

email.subject: Office document drops encoded PowerShell that calls out
